reviewFlags.issue: No page found for the Israeli-sold NC-DK1. Israeli listings in search (NCDK1BXE, NCDK1WXE) are different suffix codes and were not fetched or used. The NC-DK1 pages describe a 220-240 V unit marked NOT FOR USA. A person must confirm that the store's NC-DK1 is the unit sold in Israel before listing it.
Catalog says 1850W-2200W. Two retailer pages for NC-DK1 (SamStores, Amazon) and WorldWideVoltage state 3000 W.

Catalog says 230 H x 223 W x 158 D mm. SamStores gives 135 W x 255 H x 230 D mm, which is a different shape. Only one site gives depth, so the combined row is not corroborated. Check the physical unit.
Catalog weight (about 1.0 kg without base) has no source found in this research.

Manufacturer pages for NC-DK1 (panasonic.com MEA specs and MY product pages) returned HTTP 404, so the facts rest on US retailer pages only. A search snippet listed one retailer as discontinued, but that page was not fetched.
All sources are US export retailers for the 220-240 V NC-DK1; confirm the store's unit (Israeli suffix NCDK1BXE/WXE) is the same.
Catalog states 1850W-2200W; three retailer pages state 3000 W. Check the rating label on the unit.
Catalog dimensions (230 H × 223 W × 158 D mm) contradict the single retailer figure (135 W × 255 H × 230 D mm); neither verified. Measure the unit.
Catalog claims of double wall, boil-dry protection, lift-off shut-off, 77° lid opening and SUS304 are not verified by sources.
